'byung lngar snang ba byang chub sems kyi ngang*/ /ma skyes mnyam nyid gcig las g.yos pa med/ /srid par snang yang 'gro drug stong pa'i gzugs/ /gzhir snang rig pa'i ngang las g.yos pa med/ /bde sdug snang yang byang chub snying po'i ngang*/ / rang byung ye shes gcig las g.yos pa med/ /de phyir chos rnams dbyings gcig stong pa'i ngang*/ /skye med byang chub sems su shes par bya/ /'byung lngar snang ba yang rig pa'i ngang las shar ngang la snang ngang la grol/ sems can du snang ba yang ngang las shar/ ngang la snang*/ ngang las grol bas stong pa'i rang gzugs te/ kun byed las/ kye sems dpa' chen po/ sems ni ji bzhin pa yi ngo bo ste/ /ji bzhin gnyis med bde ba chen po las/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa yongs kyi med/ /spros bral nam mkha' bzhin du ye gnas la/ /dmigs pa'i yul 'das gcig ces bgrang du med/ /byang chub sems la bgrang zhing mtshon med na/ /sems kyis byas pa'i chos la rnam grangs byung*/ /sems kyis byas pa dang ni gang zhe na/ /snang srid snod bcud sangs rgyas sems can rnams/ / sems kyi rang bzhin ngo bo de las kyang*/ /byas nas mngon du phyung ste bstan pa ni/ /chen po lnga dang rigs drug snang ba dang*/ /de yi don mdzad gzugs sku rnam gnyis ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dag tu phyung nas bgrangs/ / zhes so/ /de ltar na rig pa stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong chen/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi 'od gsal/ gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i ngang las/ rang snang gi rtsal ma dag pa 'khor ba dang*/ dag pa myang 'das cir snang yang*/ gzhi snang rig pa'i ngang las g.yos pa med la/ ma dag par snang yang don gyis yod ma myaung du/ ye sangs rgyas la/ snang tshul yang sku gsum du dag ste/ thal 'gyur las/ gzhan yang rkyen gyis sems can rnams/ /sangs ma rgyas pa gcig kyang med/ /rang byung ye shes chos mthun phyir/ /'khor ba ye nas yod ma yin/

/de phyir rang rang sangs rgyas so/ /skye ba nyid ni rtogs pa la/ / mngal du gnas pa chos kyi dbyings/ /lus sems 'dus pa dbyings rig 'brel/ /lus su gnas pa sku gsum ste/ /rgas pas chos zad 'khrul snang 'gag /na bas chos rnams nyams su myong*/ /shi bas stong pa ngos gzung med/ /des na sems can sangs rgyas so/ /zhes so/ /rig pa bzhugs gnas klong chen du bstan pa ni/ rang rig klong chen don kyi dbyings 'di na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa nyag gcig bzhugs/ /du mar mi dmigs cha shas spros dang bral/ /mi g.yo byang chub snying po'i pho brang lags/ /rang byung ye shes nyid las gzhan mi bzhugs/ /rig pa'i ngo bo ka dag stong pa chen po'i don dbyings ni chos sku spros dang bral ba'i rang ngo ste byang chub kyi snying po rang byung ye shes kyi pho brang dam par gsungs pa ni/ kun byed las/ nga yi rang bzhin spros bral mi phyed pas/ /chos dbyings gnas 'di nga yis byas pa yin/ /byang chub nyid las de na gzhan mi bzhugs/ /nga yi rang bzhin ma bsgribs kun khyab pas/ /gsal ba'i nam mkha' ye shes gzhal yas khang*/ /rang byung ye shes nyid las gzhan mi bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /de nyid 'khor 'das sku gsum 'byung ba'i dbyings su bstan pa ni/ 'dod 'byung nor bu rin chen chos kyi mdzod/ /sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing khams lags/ / rig pa'i ngang ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi zhing khams te/ ma rig pa 'gro drug 'khor bar snang yang*/ sku gsum gyi rang snang*/ dag pa myang 'das snang yang*/ sku gsum gyi rang snang ste/ thams cad gnyis med sku gsum gyi 'khor lo las ma 'das par bstan pa ni/ thal 'gyur las/ gzhan yang khams gsum sems can kun/ /lus ngag yid las ma 'das pas/ /sku gsum gzhan du btsal mi dgos/ /btsal kyang rnyed pa'i gnas med do/ /ma byung byung ba med pa la/ / bltas pas mthong ba ngo mtshar che/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i rol pa ni/

/sangs rgyas sems can 'byed pa med/ /nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin du/ /rang byung rang la rdzogs pa bzhin/ /ces pa dang*/ kun byed las/ nga nyid thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po bas/ /chen po lnga dang khams gsum rgyud drug rnams/ /nga yi sku gsung thugs las gzhan med pas/ /nga yi rang bzhin nga yi bkod pa yin/ /ces pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rdo rje mkhar rdzong las/ chos sku mi 'gyur yul med kun 'byams la/ /phyi nang snod bcud shar ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /gzugs brnyan lta bur snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum rgyan du ma rdzogs chos med pas/ /thams cad sku gsung thugs las shar ba yin/ / bde gshegs zhing khams ma lus grangs med kyang*/ /nyid las byung bas sems nyid sku gsum klong*/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'gro drug grong khyer yang*/ /nyid las byung bas bag chags lus kyi 'phrang*/ /skye shi gnyis su snang ba'i sdug bsngal yang*/ /lus sems klong du grol bas 'pho 'gyur med/ /sems la skye shi med pas nam mkha' 'dra/ /lus la snying po med pas chu bur 'dra/ /lus sems gnyis su med pas rdo rje 'dra/ /thams cad rdo rje snying por sangs rgyas pas/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis mi nyams bshig tu med/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ /rje btsan (1) lta bur kun gyis ma rig pa'o/ /zhes so/ /rtsa ba gcig tu bstan pa ni/ klong chen nyag gcig sus kyang ma byas pa/ /'di las kun 'phros ma lus chos so cog /rgyu 'bras bzlog pas rtsa ba'i 'phro gzhir gcig /de nyid stong gsal chos nyid yangs pa che/ /phyogs ris med pa'i nam mkha' dag par gsal/ /'khor 'das dgag sgrub kun gyis gang la gang byung bltas pas rig pa stong gsal la thug ste/ zang thal chos zad rjen pa nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil ltar dag pa ni/ yi ge med pa las/ don gyi ngo bo rig pa de nyid la/ / byas pa ma yin byed mkhan ga la yod/

/bcos pa ma yin bcos pa'i bdag po med/ /lta ba ma yin lta byed chos dang bral/ /mthong ba ma yin mthong byed rnam par gsal/ /snang byed ma yin snang ba'i phyogs dang bral/ /bri ba ma yin thogs med phyogs bcur khyab/ /rtsol ba ma yin rtsol sgrub chos dang bral/ / gcig pu ma yin du ma'i chos dang bral/ /lta byed ma yin rtag chad gnyis las 'das/ /zhes so/ /rig pa gcig pu chos kyi dbyings su bstan pa ni/ rang byung gcig gis 'khor 'das kun byas kyang*/ /rtsa ba'i rig pa sus kyang ma byas par/ /nam mkha' bzhin du bya rtsol 'das par gnas/ /dpe don mthun pas dbyings gcig klong chen dang*/ /du ma'i sgro dang bskur pa zhi ba yin/ /rig pa nam mkha' lta bu byang chub kyi sems ma rtogs pas 'khor ba byas/ snod bcud du snang*/ rtogs pas myang 'das byas/ sku dang ye shes su snang ste/ rig pas kun byas kyang rig pa gcig pu sus kyang ma byas par ye nas lhun grub tu gnas pa'i dpe nam mkha'/ don rig pa/ rtags byang chub kyi sems las ma 'gags par 'char ba 'dis shes te/ kun byed las/ nga ni ston pa kun byed byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems ni kun byed rgyal po ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas byang chub sems kyis byas/ khams gsum sems can byang chub sems kyis byas/ / snang srid snod bcud byang chub sems kyis byas/ /rgyu 'bras dpe don gtan tshigs mthun par byas/ /rgyu yi dus na 'byung chen lnga byas nas/ /'bras bu'i dus na khams gsum sems can byas/ /dpe yi dus na kun dpe nam mkha' byed/ /don gyi dus na kun don skye med byed/ /rtags kyi dus na kun byed byang chub sems/ /gtan tshigs dus na rang byung ye shes ston/ /rgyu 'bras dpe don gtan tshigs mthun par byas/ /byang chub sems kyis kun byas gcig ma byas/ /kun byas byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin byas/ /gcig ma byas pa nyid la bya mi dgos/

/kun byed nga yi rang bzhin ma rtogs par/ /nga yis byas pa'i chos la nges brtags pas/ /brkam zhing chags pa'i dbang gis snang ba grub/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i rang bzhin 'jig par 'gyur/ /cha med dmus long lta bu'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /rig ngo bsam brjod las 'das par bstan pa ni/ yod med 'das pa don gyi snying po la/ /chos kun ma 'gags rol pa ci shar yang*/ /rang ngo bsam bral brjod du med pa'i klong*/ /sgra tshig tha snyad kun las 'das pa lags/ / rig pa'i ngang las 'khor 'das ci shar yang*/ /ngo bo gzhi snang chen po ka dag gi rang mal dbyings lhun grub rang byung gi ye shes la gang du'ang grub pa med de/ mu tig phreng ba las/ thog ma nyid kyi ka dag la/ /'khrul zhes tsam du brjod du med/ /de bzhin ma 'khrul pa yang ci/ /de phyir 'khrul pa gdod nas dag / gzhir snang chen po de nyid la/ /ma rig pa zhes brtags med pas/ /'khrul pa grub pa yod ma yin/ /blo zhes kun du ma brtags pas/ /dri ma 'khru ba'i ming yang med/ /m-ing dang yi ge tshig med pas/ /brtags pa'i 'khrul pa yod ma yin/ /chos shes ming du ma grags pas/ /blo brtags 'khrul pa'i ming yang med/ /sems dang yid du ma grub pas/ /'gyu byed 'khrul pa ngang gis med/ /phra rags dri ma gnyis med pas/ /'byung rkyen 'khrul pa ngang gis med/ /bya dang byed pa gnyis med pas/ /yul 'dzin 'khrul pa ga la yod/ /yul dang dbang po gnyis med pas/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa med pa'o/ /zhes so/ /rig pa gcig la kun snang yang*/ /gcig las ma g.yos bstan pa ni/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po byang chub la/ /gnyis su med de bgrang na brjod mi lang*/ /sangs rgyas sems can snang srid snod bcud gsal/ /ji bzhin chos nyid gcig las g.yos pa med/ /rig pa gcig gi ngo bo gang du'ang brjod du med pa'i ngang las 'khor 'das snang srid bsam gyis mi khyab grangs med pa shar la/

shar dus gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i ngang las ma 'das te/ kun byed las/ thams cad 'byung ba'i snying pau byang chub la/ /gcig tu med la bgrangs na brjod mi lang*/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung sems can lus ngag kyang*/ /byang chub sems yin ye nas gzung 'dzin bral/ /ces so/ /rig pa gcig tu mjug bsdu ba ni/ gcig la kun 'brel chos rnams rdzogs pa ni/ /byang chub sems kyi che ba'i yon tan te/ /gang snang dus nas tha snyad sgro 'dogs chod/ /gnyis med sems nyid stong pa'i rang gdangs su/ /phyi yi chos rnams shes par bya ba dang*/ /nang gi chos rnams rig pa zang ka ma/ /gcig dang du ma med pa'i chos nyid du/ /dbyings gcig rtag pa rig pa'i gnad du bkrol/ /phyi yul du snang ba'i chos thams cad rig pa'i rang gdangs shel 'od ltar ma 'gags pa'i yon tan du shes pas gzhan du 'dzin pa'i blo dang bral ba ste/ gzung ba'i yul ma grub nang gi chos rig pa zang ka rjen par bud pa shel gong ltar rtogs pas 'dzin pa'i sems med de ka dag chos zad/ yul sems gnyis med byang chub sems kyi rang snang rol pa'i dbyings su rtogs pas chos nyid rang byung gi ye shes gcig pur chos thams cad ro gcig pa ni/ rdzogs pa rang byung dbang gi chu bo'i rgyud las/ chos sku stong pa nyid kyi ngang*/ /rang byung ye shes rtog med dbyings/ /stong gsal rig pa'i snying po bstan/ /stong zhing bdag med ye shes dang*/ /chos rnams lhun grub rdzogs chen pa/ /zhes pa dang*/ sku gsum thug phrad las/ 'dod 'byung nor bu rin chen chos kyi dbyings/ /rtsol ba med par thams cad rang byung bas/ /rang byung ye shes 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i dpal/ /thams cad 'dus pa rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /'du 'bral med pas gnyis med byang chub sems/ /bdag gzhan med pas mnyam nyid chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes so/ /da ni chos thams cad rang byung gi ye shes gcig tu 'gag bsdams pa las snang shes nyid rang byung gi ye shes su 'gag bsdam pa ni/
chos kun ro gcig 'gag tu bsdam pa ni/ /yul snang thams cad rdzun snang stong pa'i

ngang*/ /ji ltar snang ba bzo med gcig tu zhog /gang snang thog der stong gsal nyag gcig 'char/ /gang snang dus na gsal la ma 'gags 'dzin med chen por rig pa rang dngas su bzhag pas stong gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i chos nyid 'char te/ khyung chen las/ snang shes thog babs rang byung chen po'i 'gag /rang shar spros bral rgyu rkyen bar du bsdam/ /zhes pa dang*/ kun byed las/ ma lus skye med rnam dag ting 'dzin ni/ /sgom dang mi sgom rkyen la rag ma lus/ /bsgom bya ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /gang du ji ltar bzhag pa'i tshul med pas/ /ma btsal rang sar bzhag pas sgom pa yin/ /ces pa dang*/ klong drug pa las/ gzung ba med pa'i sems nyid la/ /ma 'gags dag pa'i snang ba ni/ /rol pa chen po'i ting 'dzin zhes/ /kun tu bzang po nga yis bstan/ /ces so/ /shar grol rang byung gi ye shes su 'gag bsdam pa ni/ sems snang rtog tshogs rang gsal stong pa'i ngang*/ /gang ltar 'gyus pa rang babs lhug par zhog /'gyu 'phro'i thog nas chos nyid dgongs par gsal/ / gang du 'gyu yang chu dang dba' rlabs ltar rang byung ye shes kyi rol par shes na klod pas gnas 'gyu gnyis med du grol te/ khyung chen las/ yid dang sems kyi cho 'phrul ci snang 'gag /chos dang yid la byed pa'i bar du bsdam/ /zhes pa dang*/ kun byed las/ sgom du med pa'i chos nyid byang chub la/ /sgom dang bsgom par bya ba gnyis med pas/ /ma bsgoms rang bzhin bzhag na sgom pa yin/ /don dam kun don skye ba med pa ste/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma de bzhin rig byas nas/ /dran bsam yid la 'gyu ba ma lus kun/ /skye ba med pa'i ngang las mi yengs pas/ /gang ltar bsams kyang sgom pa yin shes na/ /ma bsgoms gang ltar bzhag kyang yeng ba med/ /ces pa dang*/ klong drug pa las/  dran pa (1) med pa'i sems nyid la/ /'gyu byed rang dag snang ba ni/ /'dzin pa rang grol bsam gtan zhes/

/kun tu bzang po nga yis bstan/ /ces so/ /gnas 'gyu gnyis med du 'gag bsdam pa ni/ yul sems bar med mnyam pa'i rang dus na/ /rang sangs rjes med dmigs gtad bral bar gzhag /ngang dngas don las lhag mthong ye shes gsal/ /snga ma gnyis bskyangs pa las/ yul sems bar med du seng nge ba zhar la 'byung ba dang*/ snang thog tu mig dang shes pa ha re ba gtad pas rang sangs rjes med du nang du gsal te/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ rig gsal chos nyid yul la phar bltas pas/ /sna tshogs bral ba'i rig pa nang du mthong*/ /rang rig du ma'i yul la phar bltas pas/ /chos sku rtog med chen po'i nang du rnyed/ /ces so/ /'gag bsdam tshul ni/ khyungachen las/ bya bral klong chen ma btsal chen po'i 'gag /lus ngag bya bral snang stong bar du bsdam/ /zhes pa dang*/ kun byed las/ bya ba med pas rtsol ba'i las mi byed/ /dmigs pa med pas sgom pa'i 'du shes bral/ /'du 'bral med pas ma brjed yid la zhog /ces pa dang*/ klong drug pa las/ blang dor med pa'i sems nyid la/ /phyogs med rang grol snang ba ni/ /khyab gdal chen po'i dgongs pa zhes/ /kun tu bzang po nga yis bstan/ /ces so/ /de dag gi don bsdu ba ni/ snying po gcig la gnad gsum 'gag bsdams pas/ /rtogs dang mi rtogs ye nas mnyam pa dang*/ /yul sems gnyis med chos skur mnyam pa dang*/ /gol sgrib gnyis med dgongs par mnyam pa dang*/ /bar mtshams med pa don gyi rang sa zin/ /btang gzhag med pa nges pa'i snying po rnyed/ /'gro 'ong med pa chos nyid dgongs par gnas/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i sa la 'ub chub bo/ /snang ba cog gzhag gi yul sems gnyis med du mnyam pas btang bzhag med pa'i dgongs pa rnyed pa dang*/ rig pa cog gzhag gi 'gyu 'phro ting 'dzin du shar nas rtogs dang mi rtogs mnyam ste 'gro 'ong med pa'i dgongs pa rnyed pa dang*/ gnas 'gyu gnyis su med pa'i gol sgrib gnyis med du mnyam pas bar mtshams med pa'i dgongs pa rnyed pa'o/

/de gsum tha dad med pas 'gag bsdam pa yang rang dwangs chos nyid las ma yengs pas tshogs drug lhug par glod pa de/ khyung chen las/ lhug pa so gnyug rnal ma drod kyi 'gag /rang sor dkyus te 'khor 'das bar du bsdam/ /zhes pa dang*/ kun byed las/ kye ji bzhin rtsol bral bde ba chen po la/ /sgo gsum mi rtsol bcos shing dmigs mi byed/ /yid la mi byed mtshan ma'i rjes mi 'brang*/ /rang byung ye shes bde ba'i don la gzhag /rang lus ma bcos dbang po mi rtul te/ /ngag kyang mi bsdam bya rtsol byar yang med/ /sems kyang gar btang mi g.yo ngang la gzhag /ces pa dang*/ klong drug pa las/ bying rgod med pa'i sems nyid la/ /btang snyoms chen po'i sgom pa ni/ /tshogs drug lhug pa'i dgongs pa zhes/ /kun tu bzang po nga yis bstan/ /ces so/ /de dag kyang dus gsum mnyam nyid du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang sbyar te/ de nyid las/ skyes bu gang zhig 'das pa'i rjes ma bzung*/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngun ma blangs/ da lta'i shes pa rang so la bzhag na shes pa thams cad snga phyi med par gcig tu 'dres nas gcig 'dus ngo bo gcig pa zhes bya ste/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rig pa'i rnal 'byor dran pa rang zad kyi thabs kyis 'khor 'das gnyis med du bsre ba ste/ 'das pa'i dran pa rnam par mtshams bcad pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dran pa nyid mgo gnon pa dang*/ da ltar gyi dran pa rnams rang yal du btang pa ni/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rig pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /yang 'das pa'i sems la phugs mi gtad/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems la rgyab mi gtad/ da ltar gyi sems la blo mi gtad pa na (1) / dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin no/ /'das pa'i ma rig pa la gzeg ma bskur/ ma 'ongs pa'i ma rig pa la g.yab ma bor/ da ltar gyi ma rig pa la spang du ma blangs na/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin no/

/'das pa'i zhe sdang la zhe ma chags/ ma 'ongs pa'i zhe sdang la lcags kyus ma bzung*/ da ltar gyi zhe sdang la ngar ma blud na/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya'o/ /'das pa'i gti mug gi sprin ma bsdu/ ma 'ongs pa'i gti mug gi sa ma bcad/ da ltar gyi gti mug gi char ma phab na/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya'o/ / 'das pa'i sangs rgyas la lan ma gdab/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas la khu ma gdab/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas la thog ma gtod pa ni/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa zhes bya'o/ /'das pa'i 'dod chags nyid sun ma phyung*/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'dod chags rnams zhe ma bcad/ da ltar gyi 'dod chags rnams yul phyung ba ni/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa yin/ 'das pa'i phrag dog la dam du ma bzung*/ ma 'ongs pa'i phrag dog la sems ma bsdu/ da ltar gyi phrag dog la sems ma bcug pa ni/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ste/ 'khor 'das gnyis med du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po zhes bya'o zhes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi bzang rtog gnyen po'i blo nyams dang bcas pa'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas rig pa stong gsal gcig la lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi phrugs cig lhun grub tu 'byung ste/ slob dpon shrī siṃ has mdzad pa'i kha gtam gsang ba'i snyan brgyud las/ byang chub sems ni nam mkha' stong pa 'dra/ /dran dang rtog pa med pa sgom pa'i mchog /rang gi rang bzhin ma g.yos bcos pa med/ /de bzhin de nyid gang gnas dam pa'i sems/ /sangs rgyas nyag gcig mtshon pa kun dang bral/ /lta ba nyag gcig spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /sgom pa nyag gcig dran rtog mtha' dang bral/ /spyod pa nyag gcig rtsol sgrub mtha' dang bral/ /'bras bu nyag gcig spangs thob mtha' dang bral/ /ces so/ /'di'i dus na 'du 'bral med pa'i bsam gtan 'char te/

de'i ngo bo ni/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ chos sku rtog med rang sangs sgom pa yin/ /dmigs pa'i yul med rang gi don rtogs na/ /'du 'bral med pa'i bsam gtan chen po yin/ /de ni rang snang 'bras bur bstan pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ rin po che spungs pa'i rgyud las/ rang bzhin bsam gtan bar med la/ /bying rgod med pa ya re mtshan/ /ces so/ /grol ba gcig tu don bsdu ba ni/ yangs so che'o mkha' mnyam rgyal ba'i thugs/ /spangs thob med do thig le gcig gi klong*/ / rang sar grol lo rtogs dang ma rtogs med/ /zad sar phyin no blo 'das phyal par yas/ /nub pa med pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo la/ /stong khams gsal ba'i nyi zla shar ba lags/ /rig pa zang thal ye grol du rjen la sangs dus chos sku zad pa'i dgongs par phyin te rtogs pa mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo las rang byung ye shes kyi nyi zla 'od gsal ba/ rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong chen rig pa'i ngang du shar bas/ 'khor 'das 'ching gzhi'i mun pa sangs pa zhes bya'o/ /de'i tshe gdod mar grol bas te/ mtshan ma rang grol las/ dbye bsal med do lhun grub klong du grol*/ /'du 'bral med do thig le'i klong du grol/ /cir yang 'char ro nges med klong du grol/ /ces so/ /grol lugs ni thal 'gyur las/ gzhan yang grol ba'i chos nyid shar/ /gnad kyis grol bas 'bad rtsol zab/ /ye nas grol bas bskyar mi dgos/ /rang grol yin pas gnyen po med/ /cer grol yin phyir mthong sar grol/ /yongs su grol bas rang bzhin dag /dus kyis grol bas goms mi dgos/ /rang bzhin grol bas ma bcos pa'o/ /grol zhes tha snyad tsam nyid de/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs su yi chos/ /de la grol zhes su la dmigs/ /khams gsum 'jug pa su la srid/ /srid mtha' bral ba'i chos nyid do/ /zhes pa dang*/ mu tig 'phreng ba las/ ye grol yin pas gtan nas 'phags/ /rang grol yin pas yur rkyen zad/

/cer grol yin pas snang ba dag /mtha' grol yin pas mu bzhi 'gag /gcig grol yin pas du mar rtogs/ /rkyen rnams rkyen gyis grol bas na/ /dmigs pa'i chos la nga mi ltos/ /yul rnams yul gyis grol bas na/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis la nga mi ltos/ /rgyu nyid rgyu yis grol ba la/ /'khor 'das gnyis la nga mi ltos/ /chos rnams chos kyis grol ba la/ /tha snyad tshig la nga mi ltos/ /sems nyid sems kyis grol ba la/ /mtshon brjod blo la nga mi ltos/ /dri mas dri ma 'khru ba bzhin/ /de bzhin dag pas dag pa grol/ /dug gis dug rnams 'joms pa dang*/ /lcags kyis lcags rnams gshog pa dang*/ /rdo yis rdo rnams gcog pa dang*/ /shing gis shing rnams bsregs pa ltar/ /rang rang dgra ni rang gis byed/ /rigs mi mthun pas grol ba min/ /ces so/ /ye nas grol ba'i rnam dag sbyar ba yang*/ /de las 'bad pas grol ba ma yin te/ /ye nyid nas ni grol bar gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las/ /pha dang ma nyid rgyu nyid dag /'phen pa'i rlung gis bskyod pa ni/ /byang chub rang rig bde chen po/ / 'byung lnga'i rgyu las sa bon ni/ /stong nyid yul las snang ba shar/ /gnyis kyis bde ba'i snyoms 'jug ni/ /thabs las byung ba'i shes rab nyid/ /mngal gyi lhums su tshud pa na/ /rang rig zhi gnas snang ba shar/ /bdun tshan bdun gyi rtogs tshad do/ /zla bcus sa rnams bgrod pa nyid/ /btsas pa nyid ni skur bzhengs te/ /lus bskyed pa ni gzhi snang yul/ /lus su gnas pa gzhi yin te/ /rgas pa dag gis 'khrul pa sangs/ /na ba nyid ni rtogs pa'i gdeng*/ /shi bas chos nyid stong par grol/ /de ltar gzugs snang sems can de/ /'bad pa med par ye nas grol/ /e ma ho/ spyod pas ma bsgyur snang ba grol/ /sgom pas ma btsal chos can grol/ /lta bas ma rtogs rtag chad grol/ /'bras bu ma bcings rang lugs grol/ /ces so/ /da ni chings su bcing pa las/

dbyings gcig rang byung ye shes su bcing ba ni/ rang rig gcig gis chos kun bcing ba ni/ /mtha' yas mu med snang zhing srid pa'i chos/ /'khor 'das ma lus shar yang dbyings nas shar/ /de phyir dang po shar ba'i dbyings kyis bcings/ /chos thams cad rig pa'i ngang las shar bas/ dang po shar ba'ang rig pa gcig gis bcings te/ kun byed las/ rgyu rkyen med pa'i snying po 'di/ /kun la dbang bsgyur thams cad byed/ /ces so/ /ji ltar snang yang rig par bcing ba ni/ /da ltar sna tshogs snang ba'i dus nyid nas/ /rig pa'i ngang las gzhan du ma g.yos pas/ /snang ba rang byung rig pa'i klong gis bcings/ /da ltar ji ltar snang yang rig ngor snang la/ rig ngor bcings te/ kun byed las/ yin ni byang chub sems yin te/ / gnas ni chos nyid dbyings na gnas/ /gsal ni rig pa mkha' la gsal/ / ces so/ /mthar yang rig pa gcig tu bcing ba ni/ shar grol ris med dbyings su nub na yang*/ /byang chub sems las gzhan du  ma gyur pas (1) / / zad pa gdod ma'i chos nyid gcig gis bcing*/ /chos thams cad mthar rig pa'i ngang du bzlog cing grol te/ nam mkhar sprin rnams dengs pa'i dpe ltar rig stong chos sku'i dbyings su zad pa chos nyid chen por bcing ba ni/ mtshan ma rang grol las/ gcig dang tha dad 'dzin pa 'khrul ba'i sems/ /gcig tu grol lo chos nyid klong du grol/ /'khor ba'i lam du 'dod pa'i byang chub gegs/ /rang byung grol lo ye shes klong du grol/ /ces so/ /thams cad rang byung ye shes su bcings pas don bsdu ba ni/ de phyir chos kun rig pa gcig gis bcing*/ /rig pa ma g.yos byang chub snying po la/ /'pho 'gyur med pa don gyi snying po bcings/ /mi 'gyur 'dus ma byas su 'ub chub po/ /snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad rig pa kun tu bzang mo'i chos nyid du 'dus pas rig pa byang chub kyi sems las gzhan pa'i chos med de/

seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ kun tu bzang mo'i bha ga klong yangs su/ /snang srid 'khor 'das 'byung ba rnam lnga 'ub/ /ces pa dang*/ kun byed las/ de bas snang srid snod bcud thams cad kun/ /nam mkha'i ngang na mi gnas med pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems kyi klong chen yul che bas/ /sangs rgyas sems can snod bcud kun kyang gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ sems las ma gtogs pa yi chos rnams ni/ /nga las byung ba'i sngar 'das sangs rgyas la/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yis lung ma bstan/ /da ltar bzhugs dang slad kyi 'byon pa la/ /kun byed rgyal pos byang chub lung mi ston/ / ces so/ /da ni thams cad rang byung gi ye shes su la bzla ba las/ thog mtha' med pa don gyi snying por la bzla ba ni/ la bzla gcig pur rang byung ye shes nyid/ /thog ma dang ni tha ma med pa'i dbyings/ /thams cad de (1) chub spros kun nyer zhi ba (2) / /chos kun chos nyid don gyi snying por gnas/ /thams cad snang bzhin pa'i dus nas/ thog mtha' med pa rang byung gi ye shes su 'dus pas stong gsal don gyi snying po'i ngang las ma g.yos te/ kun byed las/ nang nas ma g.yos nang du btsal ba'i yul med de/ /yul phyir chags shing yul la bsngo ba'i dmigs pa med/ /mi 'byung mi 'jug bdag med snying rje de yis ni/ /gzhan gyi nor min mi 'ong ye nas gnas pa yin/ /ces so/ /gzung 'dzin yul med rang byung gi ye shes su la bzla ba ni/ 'di ltar phyi nang yul sems 'khor 'das chos/ /rags phrar phye bas cha shas spros dang bral/ /mkha' bzhin ye stong dbyings su la bzla'o/ /phyi nang gzung yul rdul phran cha med stong pa de yang rig pa'i ngang du rang snang la/ nang sems kyang skad cig cha med stong par rang yal rjes med du rig par sangs la/ gnyis ka ye stong rtsa bral nam mkha' ltar dag pa ste/ mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' che las/ phyi nang gnyis ka phyi nyid nang*/ /zab mo cha shas rtogs yul med/

/srid pa ming tsam log pa'i stobs/ /zhes so/ /rig pa mtshon brjod las 'das par la bzla ba ni/ byang chub sems kyang dpyad na dngos med de/ /skye ba med dang gnas pa med pa dang*/ /'ong ba med dang 'gro ba med pa dang*/ /mtshon du med dang brjod las 'das pa ste/ /blo 'das dgongs pa'i klong du la 'das

(1) pas/ /'di zhes bstan du mtshan ma'i dngos po med/ / sgra yis shes su tshig gis brjod du med/ /rig pa rang byung gi ye shes las snang srid 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin theg pa ci byung ci shar yang*/ rig pa byang chub kyi sems su 'dus shing rdzogs pas rdzogs pa chen por 'dus pa ste/ chos nyid byang chub kyi sems des kun la khyab cing thams cad de'i ngang du gnas kyang*/ de'i ngo bo la bsam brjod spros pa'i yul las 'das pas nam mkha' ltar ye nas gnas te/ kun byed las/ kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga yi rang bzhin 'di lta ste/ /yod ni gcig las med pas te/ /bstan ni rnam pa gnyis su bstan/ /byung ni theg pa dgu ru byung*/ /'dus ni rdzogs pa chen por 'dus/ / yin ni byang chub sems yin te/ /gnas ni chos nyid dbyings na gnas/ / gsal ni rig pa mkha' la gsal/ /khyab ni snod bcud kun la khyab/ /byung ni snang srid kun tu byung*/ /bstan ni mtshan ma'i dngos por med/ /mthong du dmigs pa'i yul dang bral/ /shes su tshig tu brjod du med/ /rgyu las ma byung snying po 'di/ /sgros kyis btags pa kun dang bral/ /don 'di nges par rtogs 'dod na/ /dpe ni nam mkha' lta bur btags/ /don ni chos nyid skye ba med/ / rtags ni sems nyid 'gag pa med/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid la/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon/ /dmigs su med pa'i chos nyid la/ /dmigs su med par mtshon te bstan/ /tshig tu brjod du med pa la/ /brjod du med pa'i tshig brjod de/ /dmigs med don gyi ngo bor bstan/ /bsdus te bstan pa'i don 'di ni/ /don gyi ngo bo 'brel pa ste/ /'di yis nga don rtogs par byed/ / 'di yis nga don ma rtogs na/ /don gyi sgra tshig ci bstan kyang*/ /nga dang 'phrad par mi 'gyur te/ /nga las gol la nga bsgribs pas/ /chos kyi snying po mthong mi 'gyur/ /ces so/ /chos zad ming med chen por la

 bzla ba (1) nas don bsdu ba ni/ ming med spros dang bral ba'i klong chen du/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams la bzla'o/ /rig stong skye ba med pa'i klong chen du/ /so so rang rig chos rnams la bzla'o/ /rig dang ma rig med pa'i klong chen du/ /byang chub sems kyi chos rnams la bzla'o/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i klong chen du/ /ye stong yongs stong chos rnams la bzla'o/ /rig pa ye nas spros dang bral ba'i ngang nas shar ba 'khor 'das kyi chos so cog mthar yang der la bzla ste grol sa nyid ni thog ma'o zhes thal 'gyur las bshad pa ltar ro/ /rig pa'i chos thams cad rig stong skye ba med par la bzla ste/ mi nub rgyal mtshan chen po las/ ngo mtshar rmad byung rol pa 'di/ /bya bral nam mkha' bzhin du gnas/ /zhes so/ /byang chub sems kyi chos thams cad gnyis su med par la bzla ste/ de nyid las/ lhun gyis grub pa'i bde chen de/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rig dang ma rig gnyis med par/ /rang gi mthu yis rig pa las/ /chos ni gzhan nas 'byung mi 'gyur/ /ces so/ /stong pa'i chos thams cad 'pho 'gyur med par la bzla ste/ yang de nyid las/ 'gyur ba ma yin drang por gnas/ /nam mkha' bzhin te mtha' mnyam zhing*/ /gzhan la ltos 'gyur chos ma yin/ /ces so/ / de ltar na rang byung rig stong gi ye shes la sku gsung thugs byas pa med pa'i chos nyid ka nas dag pa'i rang bzhin lhun grub stong gsal chen por gnas te/ ngo sprod spras pa'i rgyud las/ rdo rje sku yi rang bzhin las/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs ngang du gnas/ /padma gsung gi rang bzhin pas/ /ma 'gags 'gag med snying por gnas/ /'khor lo thugs kyi rang bzhin pas/ /mi rtog bsam gtan chen por gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba chen po'i rgyud las/ sku gsum 'od gsal stong pa nyid/ /rtag pa ma yin dngos po med/

/chad pa ma yin 'od gsal sku/ /tha dad ma yin phyi nang med/ /stong pa zang thal nam mkha'i sku/ /snang stong dbyer med reg pa med/ /skye zhing 'pho 'gyur med pa'i sku/ /gsung ni skye med don gyi gsung*/ /tshig tu mi gsung don du gsal/ /smra brjod tshig las 'das pa yin/ /thugs ni rig pa mkha' ltar dag /yid med sems dang gsal ba med/ /tshor ba med pas myong ba med/ / 'du shes med pas ngar 'dzin med/ /'du byed med pas skye gnas med/ /rnam shes med pas 'khrul ba med/ /yul lnga med pas 'dzin pa med/ /'dod pa med pas chags pa med/ /dge sdig med pas rnam smin med/ /bdag tu mi lta ngar 'dzin med/ /ye shes sgo lnga 'khrul med gsal/ /kun gyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas mnyam/ /sku gsung thugs la dri ma med/ /bltar med bsgom med spyod pa med/ / sa dang lam la bgrod pa med/ /ces pa dang*/ kun gsal las/ gsal la rtog med ye shes chos kyi sku/ /rang la rang snang snod bcud ye sangs rgyas/ / las dang thugs rje'i mtha' gnyis rnam par dag /sa dang rnam thar byang chub mchog la reg /bgrod du med de chos nyid byang chub mchog /bgrod par 'dod na ye shes mtha' la ring*/ /ma bsags bzhin du tshogs gnyis ye nas rdzogs/ /ma sbyangs bzhin du sgrib gnyis ye nas byang*/ /zhes gsungs so/ / thams cad dbyings gcig rang byung ye shes ngang*/ /ma lus chos kun rnam dag ro gcig pas/ /gnyis med gcig pur gtan la phab pa'i don/ / bzhi pa'i rnam bshad rin chen 'grel 'di bshad/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba dang*/ /mkha' 'gro grub pa rig 'dzin srung mar bcas/ / chos mchog skal bzang skyai bo ma lus kun/ /zab cing rgya che'i tshul 'dis dga' bar mdzod/ /gnas lugs rin po che'i mdzod las/ chos thams cad rtsa ba rig pa'i ye shes su gcig pur gtan la phab pa ste rdo rje'i gnas bzhi pa'i 'grel pa'o// //da ni de 'dzin pa'i gang zag gi gnas la gdams pa las/

gang la gdams pa/ gang gis gdams pa/ gang gdams pa/ ji ltar gdams pa/ gdams pa'i phan yon bsngags pa dang lnga las/ dang po gang la gdams pa'i snod bstan pa las/ spang bar bya ba dang blang bar bya ba gnyis las/ spyir spang bar bya ba'i snod ni/ de ltar yang zab theg pa'i nying khu 'di/ /blo rab skal ldan nges pa'i gang zag las/ /theg pa dman dang rgyu 'bras phyogs zhen dang*/ /blo chung skal ba dman la bstan mi bya/ /skal ba dman pa la ni zab mo bstan kyang mi rtogs pa dang*/ blo chung ba ni blor mi shong bas chos spang ba dang*/ theg pa dman pa ni rang gi grub mthar zhen nas log par blta ba dang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi chos la zhen pa ni rtag tu las rgyu 'bras kho nas thams cad 'jal bas/ nam mkha' lta bu'i chos bstan yang rtsod cing sgro skur gyi gnas su lta ba'i phyir/ snod ma yin pas bla na med pa'i chos 'di gsang dgos par bstan te/ kun byed las/ kye sems dpa' chen po don 'di ni/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa can la bstan gyur na/ /'jig rten rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos bzhin du/ /rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung bar mi rigs zer/ /ces pa dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa can rnams la/ /kun byed nga yi lung 'di bstan mi bya/ /nga yi lung 'di nges par bstan byas na/ /dge sdig las la rgyu 'bras yod zer nas/ /yang dag nga la sgro dang skur btab pas/ /yang dag nga dang yun du 'phrad mi 'gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ rin po che spungs pa las/ tshig 'di dag ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i nang du rdul tsam yang brjod par ma byed cig de ci'i phyir zhe na blo chung ba'i phyir te/ de dag rnams kyis tshig 'di kun thos pas skrag pa dang*/ dngangs pa dang*/ brgyal bar 'gyur te/ gsang sngags rnams la mi mos te/ yid phyir phyung nas de'i rnam par smin pas sems can dmyal ba chen po de nyams su myong bar 'gyur bas na/ bstan cing thos pa yang lta ci smos te/

rlung phyogs tsam du yang brjod par mi bya'o zhes pa la sogs pa sngar brjod pa bzhin no/ /bye brag tu spang bar bya ba'i snod ni/ bla ma smod cing mched la khro ba dang*/ /gsang sgo 'chol zhing yongs la sgrogs pa dang*/ /dad med ser sna che zhing ngang rgyud ngan/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa can la gsang bar bya/ /bla ma dang mched lcam la mi gus shing log par lta ba dang*/ gsang ba sgrog cing yongs la ston pa dang*/ dad pa med cing ser sna che ba dang*/ ngang rgyud ngan zhing tshe 'di'i 'khrul snang bden par 'dzin pa la sogs snod du mi rung ba'i skyon chags pa rnams la bstan par mi bya ste/ snying po'i bstan pa dang slob dpon gyi sku dgrar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de skad du'ang rig pa rang shar las/ bkur sti phu dud mi byed cing*/ / gsang sngags 'chol bar spyod pa dang*/ /rigs rgyud med cing ngang rgyud med/ / shes rab chung bar gyur pa dang*/ /bka' drin khyad du gsod pa dang*/ /rang gi rigs rgyud brjod pa dang*/ /lus la rgyan bzang 'dogs pa dang*/ /don med phyal bar gyur pa ste/ /slob ma ma brtags slob dpon dgra/ /nyams su mi len gang zag la/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i don mi bshad/ /ces pa dang*/ kun byed las/ snod min log pa'i gang zag bstan pa ni/ /grags dang 'jig rten chos la dga' ba dang*/ /nga rgyal dam pa mi bkur yid phyung bzlog /'char zhing rdzas dang dad par mi ldan te/ /rang rtsod nyams len btsan thabs 'dod pa dang*/ / bstan pa yongs la 'phel zhing mi mthun dang*/ /sgro skur bdag gzhan gnod sems sgom pa ste/ /'di la mi bstan mchog tu gsang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /blang bya'i snod bstan pa ni/ skal bzang rab mchog rdzogs pa chen po'i snod/ /bla ma la gus shes rab che ba dang*/ /khong yangs spro ring gtong phod che ba dang*/ /rnam rtog chung zhing zhen pa chung ba dang*/ /tshe 'di'i (1) blos btang byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ /dad dang brtson 'grus gsang ba thub la bstan/

/bla ma chos dang mched lcam la dad pa dang*/ mos gus dang gtong phod che ba dang*/ shes rab yangs pa dang*/ khong yangs pa dang*/ ngang rgyud dwangs pa dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ dag grol dang*/ gtsang bar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog chung ba dang*/ brtson 'grus che zhing gsang ba thub pa la sogs pa snod du rung ba'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa la bstan par bya ste/ rang shar las/ dad pa'i stobs dang brtson 'grus che/ /shes rab che zhing 'dzin chags med/ /phu dud che zhing gsang sngags spyod/ /rtog med sems la g.yeng ba med/ /dam tshig ldan zhing sgrub la brtson/ /breng nge dung nge brtse gdung ldan/ /lhang nge lhan ne sgom la spyod/ /slob dpon gsung pa ji bzhin spyod/ /dam tshig 'chal bar mi gtong zhing*/ /spyod lam gzhan dang mthun par spyod/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis sems dwangs shing*/ /tshig gcig bstan pas rjes su 'dzin/ /rang gi don la de bzhin spyod/ /gsang ba gnyer gtad thub par byed/ /rdo rje'i don las mi 'da' zhing*/ /thos pa che ba'i gang zag bsten/ /rang gi don las 'da' ba med/ /dregs pa'i tshig med 'jam por smra/ /pha rol sems dang mthun 'jug byed/ /slob dpon dang ni de bzhin gshegs/ /khyad med gcig gi tshul du byed/ /de ni slob ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /de ltar ldan pa'i slob ma ni/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ kun byed las/ dad dang dam tshig brtson 'grus che ba dang*/ /snying rje yi rang skyo dang yid rtog med/ /lus dang bu dang chung ma bran dang nor/ /gang la'ang ma chags dad dang dga' bas 'bul/ / 'di dag dad dang dam tshig rtags yin pas/ /snying po'i don dang ldan pa sbyin par bya/ /zhes so/ /slob ma (1) ji ltar bya ba ni/ des kyang rtogs pas bla ma mnyes byas te/ /dam bca' sngon du btang nas legs par zhu/ /rjes su gnang nas tshul bzhin bsgrub bya ste/ /gnas lugs sa la zad par phyin par bya/ / snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma des snying po 'di zhu ba'i sngon du thabs du mas bla ma mnyes par byas la sgrub pa'i dam bca' phul nas

 zhus ta (1) / bla mas rjes su gnang nase (2) tshe 'di blos btang ste/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byas la/ da res kyi tshe 'dis 'khor 'das la bzlas so/ /gnas lugs zad par phyin par bya'o/ /kun byed las/ gang gis snying po'i bstan pa bdag thob na/ /'jig rten mtshan mas bdag la ci bgyi ste/ /thob na bdag gis dka' ba sgrub po zhes/ /dam bca' legs par gnas la bstan pa sbyin/ / ces so/ /thun mong du bya ba'i chos ni/ slob mas rang  ma rtogs pa (3) bla ma mchod cing*/ chos 'ba' zhig 'dod pas rtag tu bla ma dang chos kyi yon tan la bsam pa dang*/ bla mas kyang slob ma de thugs rjes breng nge gzung zhing dus su 'doms pas bu bzhin bskyang zhing*/ gnyis ka sems kyi 'phen pa ma chad pas phan tshun brtse gdung rgyun ma chad par bya ste/ thal 'gyur las/ man ngag lung gi rdo rje slob dpon la/ /khu bo pha dang ma dang mig /rin chen bu chung nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul/ /ces pa dang*/ rang shar las/ de ltar man ngag slob dpon la/ /rang lus dang ni rin chen rdzas/ /shin tu dkon pa dag gis bsten/ /ces pa dang*/ kun byed las/ mdor na lus dang srog kyang dbul bya zhing*/ /rdzas dang zhing yul rkang 'gros smos ci dgos/ / gal te bdag la dgos par ma gyur kyang*/ /dam pas blangs te dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ /zhes pa dang*/ rang shar las/ thugs rje'i 'brel thag ma chad cing*/ /brtse gdung rgyun thag ma chad pa/ /slob dpon slob ma'i 'brel pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gang gis gdams pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ thos mang yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla mas kyang*/ /zhes smos te/ gsang sngags rdo rje rtse mo spyi'i slob dpon ni thos pa dang snying rje che ba/ dbang dang dam tshig rdzogs pa/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong gi gnas la rang smin nas gzhan grol bar byed pa'i nus pa mnga' ba yin pas/ bye brag tu rdzogs pa chen po'i bla ma ni de'i steng du gsang chen nges pa'i dbang thob cing dam tshig dag la rgyud lung man ngag gi don la mkhas pa/

lta sgom rnam par dag pa nam mkha' lta bu la rang nyid zad par phyin nas gzhan bde la 'god pa'i nus pa mnga' ba ste/ mdor na yon tan gyi chos rgyal mtshan gyi dpung rgyan ltar nub pa med pa'i gter 'chang ba ste/ rang shar las/ rdo rje don ldan slob dpon ni/ /ngang rgyud bzang zhing slob la mkhas/ / dbang thob gsang sngags don la sbyor/ /phyi nang bya ba thams cad shes/ /yi dam lha dang 'du 'bral med/ /ting nge 'dzin las yengs pa med/ /rdzogs chen man ngag don ldan pa'i/ /gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud la mkhas/ /phyi nang sgrub thabs thams cad byed/ /lta ba'i don las mi 'da' zhing*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bya ba btang*/ /yon tan nor bu rin chen ltar/ /zad med gter la spyod pa'o/ / zhes pa dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i bla ma ni/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung khungs yin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub gzhi 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes so/ / zhar la spang bya'i bla ma yang*/ rang shar las/ mi shes nga rgyal chen po ste/ /blun rmongs tshig phyir 'breng ba dang*/ /gsang sngags don la mi dgongs dang*/ / gzhan gyi zhe gcod khangs tshig dang

(1) / /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa dang*/ / dbang gi dkyil 'khor zhal ma mthong*/ /dam tshig 'chal bar gyur ba dang*/ / dris pa dag la lan mi ston/ /thos chung nga rgyal che ba de/ /slob dpon ma brtags slob ma'i bdud/ /gsang sngags ston pa'i slob dpon min/ /rdzogs chen a ti ston mi nus/ /de dang 'grogs par mi bya'o/ /zhes pas spang bar bya'o/ /ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul ni/ snod kun brtags te rim gyis gnad rnams sbyin/ /snod m-in rnams la shin tu gsang bar bya/ /bka' rgyas btab cing gtad rgyas dam du sbas/ /bla mas slob ma'i snod brtags la/ lo dang zla bar nyams su len du bcug nas gnad rnams rim gyis sbyin pa las dus gcig ma yin te/ snod min kha gsag can gyis dus gcig thob na bstan pa 'chol zhing byin rlabs yal bar 'gyur la/ snod ldan yin yang sgrub pa ma smin pas chos la blo 'dred pa'i phyir skyon yod pa'i phyir te/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i dus gnad brtag pa las/ de yang dus gcig ma yin rim pas su/ /snod rnams brtags la legs par sbyin bya zhing*/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa can la gdams gzhug sba/ /zhes pas/ snod ldan yin na chos la gus pa yod pas yon dang bsnyen bkur dang bcas nas zhus te/ yo byad la 'dod pa med kyang pha rol gyi byed pas shes te/ snod min ni kha gsag gi phyag rten las don gnyer med pas rten 'brel gcig pa'i phyir te/ kun byed las/ sngon du brtags dang dad pa brtag bya'i phyir/ /rin chen dbyig dang bcas pas gus snod kyis/ / chags sems nga rgyal gzhan sems ma nges la/ /de la kun byed rgyal po bstan mi bya/ / zhes so/ /de'i phyir snod ldan la bstan zhing snod min la gsang zhing*/ rang shar las/ man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ /snod ngan phal du blugs mi bya/ /dad dang ldan pa 'ga' yi bcud/ /snod ngan dag du blugs gyur na/ /bcud med gnyis su 'phung bar byed/

/de phyir blo dman rnams la gsang*/ /zhes so/ /gsang tshul blo dman pa la zab mo 'di bstan par yid kyis mi bsam/ tshig 'bru ngag tu mi brjod/ glegs bam lag tu mi gtad pa dang*/ snod ldan la'ang snod min la gsang ba'i bka' rgyas gdab cing*/ snod ldan la bstan pa'i gtad rgyas dam du sba bar gdams pa'o/ /gang gdams pa'i snying po bstan pa ni/ skal ldan rab mchog snying gi bu rnams la/ /nges don snying po bstan pa gtad par bya/ /'di la bstan pa dngos dang*/ gang la gtad par bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni rig pa byang chub kyis sems/ rgyu 'bras bya rtsol las 'das par ston pa'i tshul te/ lta bas gtan la dbab pa dang*/ dgongs pas ngang la bskyal ba dang gnyis las/ dang po ni rig ngor ci snang yang rig pa las ma gos (1) shing phan gnod med pas/ rgyu 'bras dge sdig las 'das pas zang thal chig rdzogs chen po ste/ kun byed las/ rtog med nam mkha' chos kyi sku/ /nga ni mi rtog blang dor med/ /blang dor med de nam mkha' 'dra/ nam mkha' blang dor med pa bzhin/ /kun tu bzang la blang dor med/ /blang dor med pa nga la 'dus/ /zhes so/ /ngo bo rgyu 'bras med par yang de las/ byang chub nam mkha'i rang bzhin te/ /nam mkha' la ni rgyu 'bras med/ /ces pa dang*/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ dge bas sangs rgyas don mi rtogs/ /dge bas sangs rgyas don rtogs na/ /rdzogs chen gnas lugs brdzun par 'gyur/ /sdig pas 'khor bar ltung mi 'gyur/ /sdig pas 'khor bar ltung gyur na/ /rang byung ye shes brdzun par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de'i 'phreng bsal ba ni/ theg pa 'og ma nas dge sdig yod par bstan pa de/ kho rang rnal ma'i don ma rtogs pas yod yod ltar zhen nas 'khrul pas dge sdig tu snang la/ gshis byang chub sems la dge sdig med de/ tshad rims kyi thebs pa la 'khrul snang ci shar kyang don la med pa lta bu ste/ skye 'gag gi chos kyi dpe skye med la blang du med pa sa bon las myu gu skye ba'i dpe nam mkha' la blang du med pa ltar/

rgyu 'bras 'khrul pa'i dpe sems nyid don gyi ngo bo la blang du med par shes par bya ste/ kun byed las/ rdzogs chen rgyu 'bras ye nas 'das pa'i phyir/ /btsal zhing bsgrubs pas byar med 'grub pa med/ /rgyu 'bras lta ba'i ston pa lung bstan pa/ /'jig rten mtshan ma'i chos la tshod btsugs nas/ /rgyu 'bras (1) btsal nas 'bras bu sgrub par byed/ /sems las rgyu med ye nas 'bras bu med/ /byang chub sems la skye ba med pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten skye bo'i chos la dpe blangs nas/ /skye las 'jig pa 'byung bar sgro mi btags/ /rang byung rgyu 'bras 'das pa ma rtogs par/ / 'jig rten mtshan ma'i chos la tshod btsugs nas/ /rgyu las btsal bas 'bras bu byung zer ba/ /de yi rgyu 'bras theg pa rang lung yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig ye shes ye shes zhes su bstan pa ni/ /rang byung ye shes ma 'gags kun dang mtshungs/ /rgyu las ma byung mtshungs med ye shes de/ /thams cad skye ba gzhan nas chos 'byung med/ /'jig rten rgyu 'bras chos la tshod btsugs nas/ /btsal bas med pa'i 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni rgyu yis ma bskyed phyir/ /'jig rten skye 'gag chos la tshod mi 'jug /byang chub sems ni rkyen gyis ma bskyed phyir/ /'jig rten skye 'gag chos la dpe mi len/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ che ba 'dod nas sgom sgrub rtsol byed na/ /sgom sgrub rtsol bas che ba de mi 'grub/ /che ba rang byung ye shes ye nas yin/ /ces so/ /thun mong ltar rgyu 'bras kyis sangs rgyas bsgrub mi dgos te/ bsgrubs pas nam yang mi 'grub nyid 'dus ma byas chos sku 'bras bur kun 'dod la/ de nyid bsgrubs pas 'grub na 'dus byas su 'gyur la/ de mi rtag par 'gyur bas/ ma bcos ji bzhin bzhag pas 'grub par dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa mthun te/

de nyid las/ sangs rgyas bsgrubs pas 'grub par ma yin te/ /ma btsal rang bzhin gnas pas lhun gyis grub/ /ma btsal rang bzhin gnas la mi rtog zhog /ces pa dang*/ yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ /byang chub sems las gzhan med de/ /snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang sems ma bcos sngar mthong rtogs/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /ma bcos pa yi rang sems de/ /ma bcos ji bzhin rtogs gyur pas/ /da ltar 'gro ba'i don yang mdzad/ /slad nas 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang byung sems nyid 'di la ni/ /snga ma bcos par lung ma bstan/ /da ltar rin chen sems mi 'chos/ /ma bcos lam du zhugs nas 'byon/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams la/ /byang chub sems su ma rtogs te/ /bcos shing bsgrubs pas 'grub mi 'gyur/ /ma rtogs bcos pas 'grub par byed/ /bskal pa du ma'i grangs bgrangs kyang*/ /mi rtsol bde dang 'phrad mi 'gyur/ /kye sku gsum sems las ma bcos phyir/ /sku gsum ston pa'i mdo lung las/ /'chos par byed pa'i don 'byung ba/ /de ni ston pa sku gsum yang*/ / nyid kyi rang bzhin ston pa min/ /de bzhin 'chos par byed pa yi/ /ston pas bden tshul ci bstan kyang*/ /nges lung ma yin drang lung yin/ /ces so/ / dgongs pas ngang la bskyang ba ni/ de ltar rig pa chos sku rjen pa rgyu 'bras dge sdig las 'das pa zang ka chos zad blo 'das kyi don ma bsams ma dpyad rang sar cog gis bzhag dus rang gsal du sa le/ stong gsal du me re/ ye gsal du phyam me ba 'di ka yin pas/ de'i ngang la ma bcos ma bslad par rang babs su phyam me/ rang sangs su sang nge*/ rang grol du shig ge rang dag tu sal le/ rang mal du lhod de/ sgo lnga rang yan rgya grol du har sang bar med/ phyal ba nam mkha' klong yangs kyi ngang du dus gsum blo'i 'brel thag bcad pas gsal ba ma 'gags rtog med rjen par phyam gdal nas bzhag pa ni/

kun tu bzang po thugs kyi me long las/ gsal la ma yengs gting dpag dka' ba'i ngang*/ /stong gsal gdal na bde chen dbyings la spyod/ /rtse gcig ngang na don dam dbyings kyi ngang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ mu tig 'phreng ba las/ stong zhing gsal la gsal zhing khyab/ /bsam pas ma sbags dran pas sangs/ /spros pa nyid dang bral ba ste/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab cing stong*/ /rang dag mtshon pa kun dang bral/ /ces pa dang*/ klong drug pa las/ rang rig skal mnyam stong nyid grogs/ /'di la goms pa'i skal che bas/ /rtog pa med pa'i sku bzung ste/ /nga yi thugs rje'i 'od bzung nas/ /'di dang nga nyid skal ba mnyam/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ rang bzhin snang ba ma 'gags par/ /blo rmongs dran pa kun zad de/ /snang ba rang dag dbyings su ni/ /rtog pa med pa'i rig par yang*/ /mi g.yo mnyam pa nyid shes pas/ /thams cad mnyam pa'i dbyings su yang*/ /ye nas rnam rtog zad par ni/ /rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings su gnas/ /brjod cing snang tshig gnyis med pas/ /phyi dang nang med dbyings su yang*/ /rang dal chen po'i ngang du gnas/ /phyi nang med par zang thal bas/ / mar (1) bsgribs dri ma med par ni/ /ye nas ka dag chen por yang*/ /rnam par dag pa'i dbyings kyi ni/ /mtshan nyid du ni ye nas bzhugs/ /zhes pa dang*/ nyi zla kha sbyor las/ rang bzhin rdzogs chen rtogs pa yi/ /'di ltar goms pa gang yin pa/ /ma btsal bzhag pas don rnams rnyed/ /ma bsgoms par ni bde chen rgyas/ /rang bzhin nyid du mngon sum rig /'di nyid su dang 'phrad pa de/ mtshams med sdig dang ldan pa yang*/ /'di nyid bsgoms pas grol bar ni/ /the tshom nyid med na ra kan/ /ces pa dang*/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ 'dzin chags med pa'i chos nyid dngos bral te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnyis med dgongs pa'i mchog /bya rtsol med pa'i chos nyid rang sar dag /'ub chub ting 'dzin chos nyid yul la 'jug

/ces pa dang*/ nor bu 'phra bkod las/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid ye nas ka dag pas/ /chos sku nyid la dngos med bsam pa med/ /phyi dang nang med yangs pa chen po la/ /yangs pa'i chos nyid mtha' bral dngos po med/ /ces so/ /dgongs pa de dag gi rang ngo rang gsal bying rgod med pa phyed gnyen pos ma bsgribs par yangs pa phyal le phyi nang bar med dag pas gol sgrib phyogs 'dzin gyi skyon las grol bas te/ thal 'gyur las/ ma goms gnas pa'i sgom pa ni/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams gsal ba la/ /yid kyis rtogs par ma gyur pa/ /shes pa nyid la dpyod pa'i yid/ /phyir la shor ba med pa nyid/ /ris can bcad pa ma yin dang*/ /gud bcad stong par ma song dang*/ / bde ba rgyun chad ma yin dang*/ /btang snyoms lteng por ma song dang*/ /dran rig gsal ba ngal gso dang*/ /sbyangs pa log chad lam stong dang*/ /'dzin cha nang du 'gyu bde dang*/ /rnam pa gsal ba'i cha 'dzin dang*/ /kha dog yig 'bru 'gyur byed rnams/ /de rnams phyogs su ma lhung na/ /ma gol gnas pa'i sgom pa'o/ / sgom pa'i mtshan nyid snang tshul ni/ /mtshan nyid stong gsal rig pa la/ /rang bzhin gang dang ma 'dres pa/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i mtha' zad dang*/ /chos nyid rang ngo dag pa'o/ /snang tshul 'khrul pa ma yin la/ /rgyu rkyen dag pa'i rang bzhin la/ /dngos dang dngos med rang dag na/ /sgo lnga'i yul zhen dag pa dang*/ /'byung ba'i rags pa dag pa dang*/ /ye shes dag pa 'phel snang ston/ / de la zad pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes so/ /de'ang rang sangs stong par g.yos pas dang po 'byung ba phra rags la bdag 'dzin dag nas/ ye shes stong gsal gyi nyams gong 'phel du 'grub pa las/ mthar phra rags 'byung ba'i rdul phran so sor dengs shing na bun yal ba ltar rdos pa dag nas rig pa chos sku ka dag la zad sar thug nas rang za zin par gsungs te/ rin po che spungs pa las/ ma gtad rang sor bzhag pa yis/ /sems kyi 'di yi tshig kun kyang*/

/sus kyang bslab pa med par ni/ /so so'i blo la go bar snang*/ /'di nyid rang gi blor goms pas/ /mi snang rtog pa med pa yi/ /snang ba thams cad rang dag nas/ / thams cad zang ma thal byung du/ /stong gsal chen po'i rigs su 'gyur/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhi/ /so so'i nus pa mi snang bar/ /na bun bzhin du mkha' la dengs/ /'khrul pa'i zhen pa sna tshogs ni/ /ji ltar bsams kyang skye med par/ /gzung 'dzin cha rnams rang 'gags nas/ /gang mi snang ste rang zad nas/ /gsal byed rang gi nyams myong bar/ /lus can kun kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i mtha'/ /chos rnams rang sar bzhag pas te/ /snang shes chos nyid zung 'jug pas/ /ye grol cog gzhag nyid la thug /dgongs pa blo las 'das pa dang*/ / mtshan bcas rang sar dag pa dang*/ /stong dang dngos po'i mtha' grol dang*/ / 'gyu zad rtog pa med pa dang*/ /blo zad yid las 'das pa'o/ /zhes so/ / khregs chod ka dag gi don mthar phyin nas 'byung ba zad pa dang*/ thod rgal lhun grub mthar phyin pas 'byung ba dag pa gnyis/ phyi nang gi rdos bcas dag tsam du 'dra yang*/ 'di nyid rdul phran cha med so sor dengs nas skad cig la ka dag tu grol bas 'od lus mi snang la/ thod rgal 'od lus des 'pho ba chen mo 'grub pa'i cha tsam ste/ 'od lus yod med kyi khyad yod do/ /ka dag gi sar grol lugs la khyad med do/ /'di lta bu'i theg pa rgyal pos thams cad zil gyis gnon cing rgyu 'bras tshe 'di la la zlos nus la/ rnal 'byor pa yang chos nyid kyi stong ra ma nyams pa rtogs pa'i gding tshad rnyed nas rgyu 'bras kyi 'khrul pa zhig ste/ dman pa'i theg pa la mi brten cing rgyu 'bras kyi grangs rtog mi smra ba ni lta ba'i phyi rgya rlabs kyis bcad de thams cad rang byung ye shes su rtogs pa'i cha las byung la/ theg pa 'og ma brgyad kyis de ltar smra mi nus te/

theg pa dman pa la thug pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang seng ge rtsal rdzogs chen po'i rgyud las/ e ma ho/ snang ba'i ye shes gsal ba che/ /rten 'brel ye shes phyogs dang bral/ /rdzogs chen gsang ba'i ye shes ni/ /kun gyi rtse mor gyur pa'o/ /rdzogs chen lta ba'i dpe mtshon ni/ /khyung chen nam mkhar lding dang mtshungs/ /theg pa'i rang skad so sor rab tu grangs mang yang*/ /seng ge wa skad 'don du med de lto ba yangs/ / wa spre seng skad 'don du med de mgrin pa dog /rdzogs chen rang skad rang rig ye shes ston par byed/ /'og mas rang rig 'don du lta ba ye nas dma'/ / zhes so/ /de'ang khyung dang po brag steng nas 'phur ba ltar/ 'og ma la brten nas gong du bgrod na/ phyis nam mkhar lding ba ltar bya rtsol med par 'jug pa 'thad do snyam pa na ma yin te/ kha cig dbang po sbyangs pas de ltar srid du bcug kyang skabs 'dir khyung nam mkhar lding dus kyi phyogs der dpe byed kyis/ khyung gi skabs thams cad kyi dpe byed pa ma yin te/ dpe ni phyogs tsam mtshon pa las/ thams cad mtshon du mi rung ste rung na don du 'gyur gyis dpe ma yin no/ /gcig tu na lha mi sems can dbang po tha dad pas/ rdzogs pa chen po ni dbang po ye nas tshig

(1) chod kyi chos te/ dman pa rnams kyi yul ma yin no/ / de'i phyir kun byed las/ lha mi sems can dbang po mi mthun te/ /la la dbang po sbyangs pa'i 'phro btsan yod/ /la la dbang po ye nas tshig (2) chod yod/ / des na dgos ched don ces bstan pa yin/ /ces pa dang*/ thun mong gi theg pa chos mngon pa mdzod las kyang*/ kha cig dang po nas de'i rigs/ kha cig sbyangs pa las 'gyur ro zhes 'don pa bzhin no/ /gnas 'di ni snga ma bzhi'i don bsdu ba dang yang 'byed du bkod pas te/ rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas spyi ni rin po che'i mdzod bzhi rim dang 'dra ba yi/ gnas dang po bzhi lde mig bzhi dang 'dra zhing*/ 'di lde mig kyang mdzod du sbas pa'i yang 'byed de lde mig lta bu yin no/ /gang la gtad par bya ba nges don snying po'i snod la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ spyir bstan pa ni khyung chen las/ bya bral glen pa'i shugs 'chang blo bde ba/ /spros med nam mkha'i yid can rnams kyis byos/ /zhes so/ /bye brag gi snod ni/ nor bu 'phra bkod las/ kye bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /rdzogs chen man ngag gsang don 'di/ /rang dgar bstan par ma yin te/ /nges pa'i lung rgyal khu byug mchog /'di nyid bstan pa'i gang zag gis/ /rigs dang spyod lam chen po dang*/ /kha dog mtshan nyid gsung du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas ni/ /khyad par 'khor la bka' stsal pa/ /kye ma khyad par 'khor tshogs nyon/ / nga yis bstan gyis legs par nyon/ /rigs kyi khyad par 'di lta ste/ /rgyal rigs dang ni bram ze'i rigs/ /de bzhin rje'u rigs chen po dang*/ /khyad par chen po'i rigs rnams la/ /gsang sngags nges don bstan par gsungs/ /yang na rigs med kha dog brtag /pho mo gnyis ni gang yang rung*/ /kha dog 'di dang ldan pa ni/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gsungs/ /yan lag rags shing kha dog nag

/so nyid thags bzangs dkar la 'dril/ /mig rtsa yid tsam dmar ba dang*/ /skra yi mtshan nyid chen po yang*/ /g.yas su 'khyil zhing kham nag mdog /lus la bkur sti chung ba dang*/ /phyi yi spyod yul tha mal mdog /tshig rnams shugs 'byung smra ba dang*/ /yang na tshig gi rnam pa kun/ /gcig gis gang ltar smras pa ltar/ /skyes bu de yang de ltar smra/ /rdzogs chen gdams ngag bstan par gsungs/ /de rnams gcig la tshang bas na/ /shan pa'i rigs sam smad 'tshong rigs/ /phyag dar khrod pa'i rigs kyang rung*/ /rigs ngan gang dag su yin yang*/ /lhag ma med par yongs su sbyin/ /gsang ba'i bcud gsum man ngag 'di/ /rigs dang kha dog brtags thabs rnams/ /nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /gsang ba'i man ngag yang bcud 'di/ /nges pa'i rgyal po 'di ltar bstan/ /de rnams ldan pa'i skyes bu la/ /gong gi gdams ngag bstan par bya/ /zhes so/ /gtad pa des ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ des kyang mi nub don gyi snying po 'di/ /kun la mi spel mi nub snying por bzung*/ /gsang sgo 'chol na bka' chad 'byung ba dang*/ /sgro skur dbang gis snying po'i bstan pa bsnub/ /de bas gsang zhing  zhi bde'i (1) yid kyis 'grogs/ /tshe 'dir chos sku rgyal po'i gtan srid zin/ /khyad par dam pa'i slob ma bstan pa gtad pa'i skyes bu des/ spyir snod min la mi spel/ snod ldan la bstan/ bye brag tu snod min la rlung phyogs su yang mi bsgrag cing*/ snod ldan la ston pa'ang snod brtags la rim gyis sbyin pa dang*/ khyad par du 'di'i bstan pa gtad pa'i snod byung dus sred phongs med par rim pas bstan la lhag ma med par sbyin nas/ bka' rgya dang gtad rgya byas la bstan pa'i snying po mi nub par zungs shig ces gdams pa ste snod min la mi spel bas sgro skur mi 'byung zhing chos spong gi las mi sog /snod ldan la bstan pas bstan pa'i snying po 'jig rten du yun ring du gnas shing las can tshe gcig gis 'khor ba las sgrol zhing sangs rgyas par byed pa'o/

/de'ang snod min la bstan na rang gzhan gnyis ka la gnod pa'i nyes pa 'byung ste/ kun byed las/ snying po'i don la blang dor mi gnas kyang*/ / mi ma yin dang 'byung po'i bar gcod cing*/ /mkha' 'gro grub pa can gyis gnyis ga la/ /dus min 'chi dang 'jigs pa'i dbang gyur nas/ /sgro skur dbang gis snying po'i theg pa bsnub/ /de bas rigs ngan gang zag spang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /snod ldan tsam la bstan par gdams pa yang*/ de nyid las/ 'jig rten zhen pa bral zhing rgyud brtags phyir/ /lus dang longs spyod bla mas kun blangs la/ /nus dang mi nus khyad par rtags ldan na/ /snying po'i don bstan kun byed rgyal po byin/ /ces so/ /khyad par mchog gi skal ldan la bstan pa gtad pa yang*/ de nyid las/ mdo lung mngon du byung ba'i bka' rgyud 'di/ /mi 'phel mi nub snying po 'dzin pa la/ /kun byed rgyal po nges par khyed la gtad/ /ces so/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don zhus nas/ gdams pa'i phan yon la bsngags pa ni/ 'di ltar skal ba rab dang ldan pa'i slob mas bkur sti dang phu dud kyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byed de/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don zhus nas nyams su blangs na 'di dang phyi ma'i legs pa kun 'grub ste/ sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po las/ rtsa ba yan lag bla ma gnyis/ /so so'i mtshan nyid tshang ba la/ /rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ / 'khor dang longs spyod rnams kyis bsten/ /lus ngag spyod pas mnyes pa yis/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bsten/ /dad dang shes rab ldan pa dang*/ /mos shing 'khrul pa med pa dang*/ /brjod bya rnams ni nor 'khrul med/ /dbang po gsal bas bla ma bsten/ /bsten pa de las yon tan ni/ / dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba las/ / yon tan dpag tu med pa thob/ /de la dmigs te bla ma bsten/ /'khor ba'i g.yul las bzlog phyir ro/

/zhes rgya cher gsungs so/ /gsang chen rdo rje rtse mo'i don gyi gnas/ /a ti yo ga lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings/ /gang gis gang la ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul/ /lnga pa'i gnas 'byed rin chen 'grel 'di bshad/ /dpag med dus nas thugs rje'i rlabs che ba/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ bstan 'dir mngon par dga' ba'i mthu stobs can/ /srung ma dam can tshogs rnams dgyes par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas thugs rjes lha mi sems can la/ /bla med rab zhugs mos dge phun tshogs ldan/ / bde gshegs gdung 'tshob theg chen snying por zhugs/ /gang yin de kun deng nas dga' bar mdzod/ /gnas lugs rin po che'i mdzod las/ bstan pa gang la bzhag pa'i gang zag gi rim pa gtan la phab pa ste rdo rje'i gnas lnga pa'i 'grel pa'o// //da ni bstan bcos yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi bya ba la/ khams gsum yongs grol chen por bsngo ba dang*/ bstan pa phyogs bcur dar rgyas su bsngo ba dang*/ gang gis ji ltar brtsams tshul brjod pa dang*/ phyi rabs skal bzang dga' ba bskyed pa dang bzhi las phyogs dang po ni/ de ltar mchog gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ /ma gab mngon du phyung nas bstan pa ni (1) / /ma lus 'gro kun gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su/ /ma 'bad bzhin du ngang gis grol bar shog /chos kyi tshul bla na med pa'i sgron ma 'od 'bar ba nyi ma'i snying po sgrib pa med pa ltar bkod cing gsal bar byas pa'i tshul 'dis khams gsum gyi skye dgu thams cad rang gi sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes rtogs nas sus kyang gang du ci yang ma 'bad par a ti rang gzhag chen por rdzogs pas kun tu bzang po che ba rang la gnas pa'i rje btsun dam par gyur cig ces pas te/ klong drug pa las/ blta ru yod pa'i sems nyid la/ /snang srid gcig par rang shar nas/ khams gsum rang sar grol ba ni/ /a ti rang gzhag chen por rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /bstan pa dar rgyas su bsngo ba ni/

lta ba'i phyi rgya rlabs kyis gcod pa'i chos/ /theg pa'i yang rtse khyung chen rgyal po'i dbyings/ /kun las 'phags pa a ti yo ga'i lung*/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /khyung nam mkha' la lding ba'i 'gros kyis sa gcod pa ltar/ lta ba thams cad phyi rgya rlabs kyis gcod pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga ste/ dmigs bsam spro bsdu thams cad las 'das pa nyid/ kun byed las/ khyung chen nam mkhar lding ba bzhin/ /spros pa med cing bsdu ba med/ /ces pa nyid theg pa kun gyi yang rtse ri rgyal gyi rtse mo lta bu ste/ mtshan ma rang grol las/ theg pa'i yang rtse a ti yo ga'i lung*/ /ri rgyal lta bu kun gyi rtser gyur pa/ /che ba'i chen po kun bzang yangs pa'i thugs/ /rang gi stobs kyis theg phran zil gyis gnon/ /ces so/ /de lta bu'i tshul ston pa'i gnas 'di nyid rin po che rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ltar nub pa med cing phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas par shog cig ces pa'o/ /gang gis ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul brjod pa ni/ sde gsum klong dgu chings bzhis rab bcings te/ /chos kyi rnam grangs bcu drug nges pa'i don/ /gnas lugs rin chen mdzod kyi rnam bshad 'di/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang pos legs par bkod/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad bsdu na/ sems sde/ klong sde/ man ngag gi sde dang gsum du 'du la/ de'ang ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i klong*/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i klong*/ /ma 'gags cir yang 'char ba'i klong*/ /rgyu 'bras bya rtsol bral ba'i klong*/ /gol sgrib gzhi nas dag pa'i klong*/ /lta sgom gdod nas dag pa'i klong*/ /byar med bcos bslad bral ba'i klong*/ /dgongs pa bar mtshams med pa'i klong*/ /chos rnams rang sar grol ba'i klong dang dgur 'dus shing*/ de thams cad kyang med pa/ phyal ba dang*/ lhun grub dang*/

gcig pu pa'i don gyi snying po mi 'gyur ba'i chings bzhis bcings pas chings bzhir 'du la/ bzhi po re re bzhin gnad bkrol ba dang*/ 'gag bsdams pa dang*/ chings su bcings pa dang*/ la bzla ba'i gnad bzhi bzhi ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs bcu drug tu bstan pa ni/ nges pa'i don mngon sum du phyung nas bkod pa ste/ rin po che'i mdzod khang ltar 'dod dgu 'byung bas gnas lugs rin po che'i mdzod kyi rnam par bshad pa zhes dpe don 'tshogs pa la ming du btags te/ theg pa rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis zhes bya ba ni/ chos nyid kyi don la lta sgom nam mkha' ltar klong yangs pa'i phyir rtsom pa po'i mtshan te/ legs par bkod ces bya ba ni phyi rabs kyi 'gro ba la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ man ngag gi rgyal po gzhan las phul du phyung ba/ rang ngo a ti'i dgongs pa ci yin pa bstan pa theg pa 'og ma'i mthar 'dzin 'joms shing zil gyis gnon pas/ don gyi snying po rdo rje tho chen zhes bya ste/ tshogs drug zil gnon las/ dus gsum skye 'gag med pa chos kyi dbyings/ /mi 'gyur mi phyed 'dus ma byas pa'i klong*/ /mtha' rnams 'joms pas rdo rje tho chen te/ /phyogs rnams zil gnon man ngag rgyal po yin/ /ces so/ /phyi rabs skal bzang dga' ba bskyed pa ni/ /gnas lugs mdzod khang gnas lnga nges pa'i don/ /zab cing rgya che 'byor pas rab brgyan cing*/ /tshig don rnam bkra'i bkod pas mdzes pa 'dis/ /skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i mdzod khang 'byor pa dpag tu med pas brgyan cing kun nas legs par bkod pas brgyan pa ltar/ rdo rje rtse mo lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzod khang gnas lnga nges pa'i rim khang tha dad par gsal ba'i nang na/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don rmad du byung ba'i 'byor pas brgyan cing tshig don bkod legs pa'i bkod pas shin tu mdzes par byas pa nyid/

phyi rabs kyi skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs la mi zad pa rin po che'i gter du bkod pa de/ yongs su spyad pa'i gzhir gdams pas mngon par dga' bar mdzod cig ces pa ni/ theg pa'i rgyal po'i don 'dir zhugs pa rnams la dam tshig rmad du byung ba dang bstan pa ring du gnas pa rten 'brel du shis pa brjod pa'i rgyan gyis mtha' bsdus te bstan pa yin no/ /de la shis pa brjod pa'i rgyan ni thams cad du bkra shis dang dge legs su byed de/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge /zhes legs par gsungs so/ /bkra shis nyin byed phan bde'i 'od stong gis/ /phyogs rnams bkra shis gling bzhi'i mun pa sel/ /bkra shis don zab ngo mtshar rmad byung gis/ /skye dgu bkra shis dam chos snang ba ston/ /bkra shis mkha' dbyings bdud rtsi sprin phung gis/ /dus rnams bkra shis 'dod dgu'i char pa 'bebs/ /bkra shis rtse mo theg pa'i rnam 'gros kyis/ /mngon par byang chub bkra shis char chen 'bebs/ /de phyir 'di na gnas lugs rin chen mdzod/ / nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam bkra shis bde legs mdzod/ /zab cing rgya che theg mchog snying po'i don/ /bskal (1) bzang rnams kyi 'dod 'byung rin chen mdzod/ /tshul 'di shes bya'i nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /blo gros 'od stong nyin mor byed pa des/ /rgyud lung man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus nas/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer dang*/ /rang gi rnam dpyod blo gros mi dman pas/ /yangs zab shes bya'i gnas la dbang 'byor te/ /'di 'dra'i tshul la blo gros ngang gis rgyas/ /theg pa'i rtse mo rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /'dzam bu'i gling las skal pa chen po'i gnas/ /rgya gar rgya nag bod yul mchog rnams su/ /dam pa rnams kyi drin las mngon par snang*/

/so so'i gnas lugs mkhas grub mchog rnams kyi/ /dgongs 'grel man ngag zab cing rgya che'i don/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed dam pa rim gyis mdzod (1) / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /de ltar rim brgyud ngo mtshar gnas rnams dang*/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po rdo rje'i gnas/ / ma lus don 'grel gnas lugs mdzod 'di brtsams/ /rdo rje'i gnas kyang shin tu rtogs dka' bas/ /tshul rol mthong ba'i spyod yul ma gyur pa/ kho bo'i nus pa tshig la dbang min yang*/ /dam pa rnams la brten nas rab tu bshad/ /sā la'i shing la brten nas 'khri shing yang*/ /che mtho'i dpal du byed pas mdzes pa ltar/ /rgyud lung man ngag bla ma'i byin rlabs las/ /zab cing rgya che gnas 'di mdzes par byas/ /blo gros lus bzang rtogs pa'i 'dab gshog rgyas/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal dag pa'i mkha' la mdzes/ /rang byung ye shes dgongs pa'i rtsal 'phang ni/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa dbyings su bcad pa lags/ /thos bsam phyogs med sgo nga'i sbubs nang nas/ /theg mchog rgyal po rdzogs pa chen po'i bya/ /nyams rtogs rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i 'dab gshog

rgyas/ /kun las 'phags pa'i dbyings su gnam 'phang gcod/ /sgo gsum sgong rgya 'di yang shag ma shig /rig stong chos sku 'di yang stong gsal yangs/ /chos dbyings zad pa 'di yang zang ma thal/ /thams cad dbyings gcig 'di yang mngon sum bzhin/ /yangs pa phyam phyam nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /rig stong rjen par bar med gcig tu bsres/ /phyi nang dbyings gcig stong gsal 'pho 'gyur med/ /chos sku rgyal po'i gtan srid zin pa lags/ /yang rab rnal 'byor tshe 'dir nges pa'i lung*/ /ka dag chos sku yid la byar med pa'i/ /rdos bcas lus la rgyal ba'i dgongs pa can/ /mi yi seng ge de yis bstan nas song/ /ye stong dbyings nas blo stong yangs pa che/ /gzhi bde'i steng na blo bde rgyun mi 'chad/ /chos zad dbyings na blo zad nyams dga' ba/ /nam mkha'i rab 'byams rnal 'byor e ma ho/ /rang mal chos sku mi rtog mkha' ltar yangs/ /rang bzhin bsam gtan bar med chu bo'i rgyun/ /rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bcad/ /kun bzang don gyi dgongs pa e ma ho/ /rang byung ye shes dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ /bya bral rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i khyung chen lding*/ /med pa phyal ba lhun grub gcig pu nyid/ /ma bcos don gyi snying po e ma ho/ /rang snang lhun grub rig pa'i klong chen 'dir/ /ji ltar snang yang ma 'gags rig pa'i rtsal/ /med pa gsal snang sgyu ma'i rol pa tsam/ /rnam pa kun ldan stong chen e ma ho/ /ji bzhin ma g.yos rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'dir/ /rang shar rang grol rang gnas mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /bde gsal mi rtog nam mkha' mtha' dbus med/ /thun mtshams 'das pa'i dgongs pa e ma ho/ /stong gsal rig pa mi 'gyur chos kyi sku/ /'khor 'das ye dag rang rig byang chub klong*/ /gzung 'dzin rang snang gzhi med chos sku'i rtsal/ /mtshon brjod 'das pa'i rtogs pa e ma ho/ /'khor ba gzhi med rtogs na mya ngan 'das/ /myang 'das ming tsam rtogs na gdod ma'i dbyings/

/bya bral yid las 'das na chos kyi sku/ /ma bsams ji bzhin bzhag na bsam brjod 'das/ / dmigs gtad zhen pa med na gnas lugs ngang*/ /chos zad blo las 'das na mthar thug don/ /yin min phyogs las 'das na mtha' bral nyid/ /re dogs rtsa ba chod na byang chub rnyed/ /'di ni mthar thug nges pa'i snying po ste/ /phyi rabs skal bzang rnams la gdams pa la/ /bdag gzhan rjes su 'jug pa'i skal ldan kun/ /zad pa'i sa la gtan srid zin par mdzod/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po rdo rje'i dbyings/ /'di dang su 'phrad yang rab nges pa'i lung*/ /'bad med yongs grol chos nyid yangs pa'i klong*/ /srid pa tha ma'i dam tshig rin chen lags/ /de bas 'dir zhugs skal bzang skye bo rnams/ /spro dga' bskyed la ma bcos rnal du zhog /spros pa'i chos dang 'jig rten 'khrul pa spongs/ /dben pa'i gnas su byar med snying po ltos/ /'di ni kho bo'i snying gtam zab mo lags/ /zhun mthar chod la sems la rtogs pa skye/ /zhen med skyongs dang dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa 'jig /gtad med gyis dang bden med shugs las 'char/ /gang snang ci shar yul sems chos kyi gnad/ /mi dgag mi sgrub rang babs mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /cog gzhag lings bskyur dgongs pa'i mthar thug nyid/ /rang sangs rjen med 'char gyis zad sar skyol/ /de ltar ma lus chos kun snying po'i don/ /gnas lugs rin chen mdzod kyi 'grel 'di bshad/ / rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang/ /phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis bde legs shog / gnas lugs rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba'i 'grel ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'byams la mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug cing*/ theg pa'i rgyal po'i gnas la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul kun tu bzang po'i khang bzang du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/
